title: Heinz edges lower after a six session rally (KHC:NASDAQ) - Seeking Alpha
summary: Heinz edges lower after a six session rally (KHC:NASDAQ) Seeking Alpha
body:
Shares of The Kraft Heinz Company (KHC) slipped 0.84% to close at $22.30 on Wednesday, snapping a six session rally.

The stock has gained around 5.5% between March 24 and March 31 compared to a 0.43% decline in the S&P 500
